Sections follow our lecture order. The section numbers in the textbook may differ.

- [**4.1 Related rates**](related-rates.qmd) · Monday, November 2. Set up a diagram, relate the rates, and evaluate at the specified instant.
- [**4.2 Maxima and minima**](18-maxima-and-minima.qmd) · Wednesday, November 4. Global and local extrema, critical numbers, and the closed-interval method.
- [**4.3 Finding Local Extrema: The First and Second Derivative Tests**](section-4-3.qmd) · Friday, November 6. Classify critical numbers using both derivative tests and locate changes in concavity.
- [**4.4 End behavior and limits at infinity**](19-end-behaviour-and-curve-sketching.qmd) · Monday, November 9. Horizontal and slant asymptotes.
- [**4.5 Curve sketching**](curve-sketching.qmd) · Monday, November 9. Use derivative sign graphs to sketch each branch.
- [**4.6 Optimization**](optimization.qmd) · Friday, November 13. Choose an objective, impose the constraints, and find a global maximum or minimum.
